title: SSH Service Not Accessible on Target Host
description: All SSH connection attempts to 76.13.46.223:22 result in 'Connection refused'. Service not running or firewalled.
risks: No SSH-based lateral movement or credential attacks possible via this vector.
attack_vectors: None - port is closed. Consider alternative ports, web shells, or other lateral movement methods.
proof_of_existence: OpenSSH_9.6p1... debug1: connect to address 76.13.46.223 port 22: Connection refused. Python socket test: ConnectionRefusedError: [Errno 111] Connection refused.

title: Shadow-garden-config Directory in /tmp (Root-owned)
description: Directory /tmp/Shadow-garden-config owned by root:root with drwxrwxrwt permissions. Contents unknown - potential config/secrets exposure.
risks: May contain sensitive configuration, credentials, or secrets accessible from /tmp.
attack_vectors: Enumerate directory contents: ls -laR /tmp/Shadow-garden-config/; cat any config files for credentials or secrets.
proof_of_existence: drwxrwxrwt 10 root root 4096 Jun 14 19:55 Shadow-garden-config — root-owned directory in /tmp with sticky bit
remediation: Remove sensitive configs from /tmp; restrict permissions; use proper config directories.
